_doc: Per-task subtask plans for partial_success annotation in inference.py. A partial success is recorded as the number of subtasks completed, in order, before the attempt failed; completing every subtask is a plain success. Plans derived from Hannibal52Barca/icl-sarm-annotations (VLM subtask annotations): the modal plan among completed episodes, trailing periods stripped. Entries marked 'normalized' or 'derived' were hand-built because the annotations were too inconsistent or missing -- see each entry's note. Matching is on the lowercased, whitespace-collapsed query against 'task' and 'aliases'. Edits take effect on the next attempt without restarting the UI.

subtasks: Place the yellow cloth onto the plate
Tilt the gripper to wipe the plate
Place the yellow cloth back onto the table

tasks.task: hit the yellow cube with the mallet using the left arm
aliases: hit the yellow cube with the left arm
subtasks: Hit the yellow cube with the mallet

tasks.task: pass the red chilli from the left arm to the right arm
subtasks: Place the red chilli onto the right arm

tasks.task: pick up the eggplant and place it on the plate with the left arm
subtasks: Place the eggplant onto the plate

tasks.task: place the red chilli in the cup with the right arm
aliases: place the red chilli in the cup
subtasks: Place the red chilli into the cup
tasks.provenance: modal plan, 43 of 54 completed episodes of 'place the red chilli in the cup'
tasks.note: icl-dataset has no task literally named '...with the right arm'; it has 'place the red chilli in the cup' (no arm) and a separate '...with the left arm' variant. The arm-less one is taken to be the right-arm task. Both variants have the identical plan.

Tilt the gripper to uncap the blue marker

tasks.task: stack the three cubes into a tower
subtasks: Place the second cube onto the first cube
Place the third cube onto the second cube
tasks.note: VLM plans were inconsistent (8 distinct plans in 10 episodes, several listing only grasps) and the colour order varies per episode, so the steps are colour-agnostic. Assumes the first cube starts on the table.

tasks.task: put the square on the peg
subtasks: Place the square onto the peg

tasks.task: stack the cubes and hit them with the mallet
aliases: stack one cube in the box and hit it with the mallet
subtasks: Place the cube into the box
Hit the cube with the mallet
tasks.note: icl-demo-dataset's task is 'stack the cubes and hit them with the mallet' (plural; its episodes grasp 2-4 cubes), while the requested name says one cube. Built from the annotation vocabulary ('Place the orange cube into the cardboard box', 'Grasp the mallet') for a single cube; the plans themselves never ground the hit step.

tasks.task: hit the eggplant with the mallet
subtasks: Move the mallet towards the eggplant
Hit the eggplant with the mallet
tasks.provenance: most complete plan (2 of 11 episodes; 9 distinct plans)

tasks.task: sort the items into their containers
tasks.note: Per-object plans name different objects every episode (6-9 objects, median 8), so progress is counted rather than named. Success means every item is sorted however many the scene has; the last button reached is items sorted before failing. 'long horizon sorting task' is mapped here rather than to 'sort the food items into the cups' (3-6 objects), as this is the longer one.

tasks.task: sort the food items into the cups
tasks.note: Included because it is the other sorting task in icl-demo-dataset. Per-object plans vary by episode (3-6 objects, median 4), so progress is counted rather than named.
